title: Each `Core\Task` reserves a 1 MiB stack, the likely source of the 1.05 MB per task a request is charged.
text: `TASK_STACK_SIZE` is `1 << 20` (`crates/nvs-host/src/stack.rs:88`), and its doc says it is the quantity an admission decision counts ahead of time. `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` measured 1.05 MB held per task, which stops `Core\Task::map` over 300 labels at the default 256 MB ceiling. Not checked: whether the request's memory account is charged the reserved size or the pages a task touches. If it is the reserved size, a cap counts memory a task never uses. Smaller stacks that grow, or charging touched pages, are the two answers. The first changes how deep a task may recurse, which is observable behaviour and goes under *Decisions for you*. Ladder: `scheduler/tasks.nvs` with the bytes column read per task.
